# Loungemote

> Loungemote is a Wi-Fi TV remote app for Android, iPhone and iPad. It controls smart TVs and streaming devices over the home Wi-Fi network, with no infrared blaster, no account and no ads. Setup, a first key press to check the connection, and the Demo TV are free; controlling a TV needs Loungemote Pro, an in-app purchase whose weekly plan starts with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers.

## Key facts

- Platforms: Android phones and tablets require Android 8.0 or later. {% if site.google_play_url and site.google_play_url != "" %}Available on Google Play: {{ site.google_play_url }}{% else %}Android is coming soon.{% endif %} iPhone and iPad require iOS 17 or iPadOS 17 or later. {% if site.app_store_url and site.app_store_url != "" %}App Store: {{ site.app_store_url }}{% else %}iOS is not yet released on the App Store; no release date is announced.{% endif %}
- Supported TVs: Samsung smart TVs with Tizen (2016 and later), LG webOS TVs, Roku TVs and Roku players, Android TV and Google TV devices (including Chromecast with Google TV), Amazon Fire TV, Vizio SmartCast, Sony Bravia, Xiaomi TVs with PatchWall, Hisense TVs with VIDAA, and Philips TVs with Titan OS or Saphi. Roku TV and Google TV models from other brands, such as TCL, work too.
- Not supported: Apple TV, infrared-only TVs, casting to Fire TV, and control from outside the home network.
- How it works: the phone or tablet and the TV must be on the same Wi-Fi network. The app finds TVs automatically; Samsung and LG TVs ask the user to select Allow once, and Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV, Vizio, Sony, Hisense and Philips Titan OS TVs show a code to type once. Roku, Xiaomi and Philips Saphi need no pairing.
- Free: finding and pairing TVs, a first key press to check that the TV responds, and the Demo TV with every feature unlocked.
- Loungemote Pro (weekly subscription with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, yearly subscription, or one-time lifetime purchase): directional pad, OK, Back, Home, volume, mute, channels, playback and power keys; turning the TV on over Wi-Fi (Wake-on-LAN) on TVs that support it; input switching on LG, Sony, Vizio and Hisense; a simple layout with big buttons; phone keyboard, apps in one tap, swipe touchpad (with the pointer on LG), casting photos, slideshows, videos, files and links to TVs, Chromecast, Roku and DLNA devices, Siri, Shortcuts and the iPad layout on iOS only (coming soon).
- Privacy: no app account, ads or advertising identifier. Remote commands go directly to the selected TV on the local network. Pairing records are protected with Android Keystore or iOS Keychain. The current Android release has no Firebase configuration and Share Usage Data is off by default. iOS has Firebase usage and crash reporting, on by default and controlled by Settings > Privacy > Share Usage Data. Google Cast has separate SDK diagnostic collection that this switch does not control.
- Screen mirroring: guides for Android system screen casting and iOS AirPlay, subject to phone and TV compatibility. Loungemote does not provide its own mirroring service.
- Purchases: weekly (3-day trial for eligible new subscribers), yearly (no trial) or Lifetime. Android uses Google Play; iOS uses the App Store. Restore with the account used for purchase. Purchases do not transfer between stores. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.
- Languages: English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian and Indonesian.
- Loungemote is an independent app, not affiliated with or endorsed by the TV makers named here.
